lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਭਉ ਭੰਜਨ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਏਕੋ ਡੀਠਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: janam janam ke kilavikh bhau bha(n)jan guramukh eko deethaa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: It is the Destroyer of the sins, the guilt and fears of countless incarnations; the Gurmukh sees the One Lord. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਕੋਟੰਤਰ ਕੇ ਪਾਪ ਬਿਨਾਸਨ ਹਰਿ ਸਾਚਾ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: kot kota(n)tar ke paap binaasan har saachaa man bhaaiaa ||
lines.translation: Millions upon millions of sins are erased, when the mind comes to love the True Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਸੂਝੈ ਦੂਜਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਏਕੁ ਬੁਝਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: har bin avar na soojhai doojaa satigur ek bujhaaiaa ||1||
lines.translation: I do not know any other, except the Lord; the True Guru has revealed the One Lord to me. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਜਿਨ ਘਟਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਸਹਜੇ ਰਹੇ ਸਮਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: prem padaarath jin ghat vasiaa sahaje rahe samaaee ||
lines.translation: Those whose hearts are filled with the wealth of the Lord's Love, remain intuitively absorbed in Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤੇ ਸੇ ਰੰਗਿ ਚਲੂਲੇ ਰਾਤੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਈ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: sabad rate se ra(n)g chaloole raate sahaj subhaaee ||2||
lines.translation: Imbued with the Shabad, they are dyed in the deep crimson color of His Love. They are imbued with the Lord's celestial peace and poise. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਸਨਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ਰਸਿ ਰਾਤੀ ਲਾਲ ਭਈ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: rasanaa sabad veechaar ras raatee laal bhaee ra(n)g laaee ||
lines.translation: Contemplating the Shabad, the tongue is imbued with joy; embracing His Love, it is dyed a deep crimson.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਹਕੇਵਲੁ ਜਾਣਿਆ ਮਨੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿਆ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਆਈ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: raam naam nihakeval jaaniaa man tripatiaa saa(n)t aaee ||3||
lines.translation: I have come to know the Name of the Pure Detached Lord; my mind is satisfied and comforted. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੰਡਿਤ ਪੜੑਿ ਪੜੑਿ ਮੋਨੀ ਸਭਿ ਥਾਕੇ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਭੇਖ ਥਕੇ ਭੇਖਧਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pa(n)dit paRhi paRhi monee sabh thaake bhram bhekh thake bhekhadhaaree ||
lines.translation: The Pandits, the religious scholars, read and study, and all the silent sages have grown weary; they have grown weary of wearing their religious robes and wandering all around.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਾਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: gur parasaad nira(n)jan paaiaa saachai sabad veechaaree ||4||
lines.translation: By Guru's Grace, I have found the Immaculate Lord; I contemplate the True Word of the Shabad. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਵਾ ਗਉਣੁ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ਸਚਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਸਾਚ ਸਬਦੁ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: aavaa gaun nivaar sach raate saach sabad man bhaaiaa ||
lines.translation: My coming and going in reincarnation is ended, and I am imbued with Truth; the True Word of the Shabad is pleasing to my mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਜਿਨਿ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: satigur sev sadaa sukh paaeeai jin vichahu aap gavaaiaa ||5||
lines.translation: Serving the True Guru, eternal peace is found, and self-conceit is eliminated from within. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਹਜ ਧੁਨਿ ਉਪਜੈ ਮਨਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: saachai sabad sahaj dhun upajai man saachai liv laaee ||
lines.translation: Through the True Word of the Shabad, the celestial melody wells up, and the mind is lovingly focused on the True Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਈ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: agam agochar naam nira(n)jan guramukh ma(n)n vasaaee ||6||
lines.translation: The Immaculate Naam, the Name of the Inaccessible and Unfathomable Lord, abides in the mind of the Gurmukh. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਕਸ ਮਹਿ ਸਭੁ ਜਗਤੋ ਵਰਤੈ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਏਕੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: ekas mahi sabh jagato varatai viralaa ek pachhaanai ||
lines.translation: The whole world is contained in the One Lord. How rare are those who understand the One Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਬਦਿ ਮਰੈ ਤਾ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਸੂਝੈ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਣੈ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: sabad marai taa sabh kichh soojhai anadin eko jaanai ||7||
lines.translation: One who dies in the Shabad comes to know everything; night and day, he realizes the One Lord. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਸੋਈ ਜਨੁ ਬੂਝੈ ਹੋਰੁ ਕਹਣਾ ਕਥਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jis no nadar kare soee jan boojhai hor kahanaa kathan na jaaee ||
lines.translation: That humble being, upon whom the Lord casts His Glance of Grace, understands. Nothing else can be said.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਸਦਾ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਏਕ ਸਬਦਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥੮॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak naam rate sadaa bairaagee ek sabad liv laaee ||8||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, those who are imbued with the Naam are forever detached from the world; they are lovingly attuned to the One Word of the Shabad. ||8||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: saarag mahalaa 3 ||
lines.translation: Saarang, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਅਕਥ ਕਹਾਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: man mere har kee akath kahaanee ||
lines.translation: O my mind, the Speech of the Lord is unspoken.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਸੋਈ ਜਨੁ ਪਾਏ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਿਰਲੈ ਜਾਣੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: har nadar kare soee jan paae guramukh viralai jaanee ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: That humble being who is blessed by the Lord's Glance of Grace, obtains it. How rare is that Gurmukh who understands. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਗਹਿਰ ਗੰਭੀਰੁ ਗੁਣੀ ਗਹੀਰੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਨਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: har gahir ga(n)bheer gunee gaheer gur kai sabad pachhaaniaa ||
lines.translation: The Lord is Deep, Profound and Unfathomable, the Ocean of Excellence; He is realized through the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਕਰਮ ਕਰਹਿ ਭਾਇ ਦੂਜੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਬਉਰਾਨਿਆ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: bahu bidh karam karahi bhaai doojai bin sabadai bauraaniaa ||1||
lines.translation: Mortals do their deeds in all sorts of ways, in the love of duality; but without the Shabad, they are insane. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਨਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ ਜਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਫਿਰਿ ਮੈਲਾ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: har naam naavai soee jan niramal phir mailaa mool na hoee ||
lines.translation: That humble being who bathes in the Lord's Name becomes immaculate; he never becomes polluted again.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਹੈ ਮੈਲਾ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਰਮਿ ਪਤਿ ਖੋਈ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naam binaa sabh jag hai mailaa doojai bharam pat khoee ||2||
lines.translation: Without the Name, the whole world is polluted; wandering in duality, it loses its honor. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਿਆ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਂ ਕਿਆ ਸੰਗ੍ਰਹਿ ਤਿਆਗੀ ਮੈ ਤਾ ਬੂਝ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: kiaa driRaa(n) kiaa sa(n)grahi tiaagee mai taa boojh na paaee ||
lines.translation: What should I grasp? What should I gather up or leave behind? I do not know.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੋਹਿ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਨਾਮੋ ਹੋਇ ਸਖਾਈ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: hohi daiaal kripaa kar har jeeu naamo hoi sakhaaee ||3||
lines.translation: O Dear Lord, Your Name is the Help and Support of those whom You bless with Your kindness and compassion. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਸਚੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਕਰਮ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਨਾਇ ਲਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: sachaa sach daataa karam bidhaataa jis bhaavai tis naai laae ||
lines.translation: The True Lord is the True Giver, the Architect of Destiny; as He pleases, He links mortals to the Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੂ ਦੁਆਰੈ ਸੋਈ ਬੂਝੈ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਆਪਿ ਬੁਝਾਏ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: guroo duaarai soee boojhai jis no aap bujhaae ||4||
lines.translation: He alone comes to understand, who enters the Guru's Gate, whom the Lord Himself instructs. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੇਖਿ ਬਿਸਮਾਦੁ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਚੇਤੇ ਆਵਾ ਗਉਣੁ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: dekh bisamaad ihu man nahee chete aavaa gaun sa(n)saaraa ||
lines.translation: Even gazing upon the wonders of the Lord, this mind does not think of Him. The world comes and goes in reincarnation.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੇ ਸੋਈ ਬੂਝੈ ਪਾਏ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰਾ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: satigur seve soee boojhai paae mokh duaaraa ||5||
lines.translation: Serving the True Guru, the mortal comes to understand, and finds the Door of Salvation. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੑ ਦਰੁ ਸੂਝੈ ਸੇ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਵਿਗਾੜਹਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਬੂਝ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jinh dar soojhai se kade na vigaaRahi satigur boojh bujhaaee ||
lines.translation: Those who understand the Lord's Court, never suffer separation from him. The True Guru has imparted this understanding.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਕਰਣੀ ਕਿਰਤਿ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣੁ ਰਹਾਈ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: sach sa(n)jam karanee kirat kamaavahi aavan jaan rahaaee ||6||
lines.translation: They practice truth, self-restraint and good deeds; their comings and goings are ended. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਦਰਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਸਾਚੁ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ ਜਿਨ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਚੁ ਅਧਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: se dar saachai saach kamaavahi jin guramukh saach adhaaraa ||
lines.translation: In the Court of the True Lord, they practice Truth. The Gurmukhs take the Support of the True Lord.
